hints.title: Six Pairwise Distance Invariant
hints.text: Four points form a non-degenerate square if and only if the 6 pairwise squared Euclidean distances contain exactly two positive values.

hints.title: Side and Diagonal Multiplicity Check
hints.text: The 6 pairwise distances must consist of 4 equal side lengths and 2 equal diagonal lengths, where diagonal squared equals 2 times side squared.

hints.title: Non-Zero Side Verification
hints.text: Compute all 6 squared distances. Verify that the side length is strictly positive, there are 4 side lengths, and 2 equal diagonal lengths.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing point permutations manually is prone to missing vertex orientation orders or degenerate overlapping points.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting 6 distance scalar integers takes O(1) time and verifies geometric validity unconditionally.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check that distance > 0 to reject duplicate points.
